verdict.rationale: Warp's docs give separate shortcuts for macOS and for Windows/Linux (warp-docs-49), which implies the desktop terminal ships on all three OSes, and a community user reports running it under WSL on Windows (warp-comm-10). A newly shipped settings file gives programmatic control over settings and 'easy portability between devices' (warp-docs-40). missing for 10: an explicit platform-support or installation doc confirming macOS, Linux and Windows builds, documentation of how the settings file syncs or is reused across OSes, and independent hands-on confirmation of identical config behaviour on each platform.
